lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Seventy candles glow tonight
On a cake by the kitchen door
Bob, you wore that Houston hard hat
And gave us forty years and more
Pipe and steel and long good days
You kept that promise, true and plain

[Pre-Chorus]
Every mile you drove before dawn
Built the life we lean on

[Chorus]
Happy birthday, Bob
We love you so
Happy birthday, Bob
You made our home
For the three kids you carried
With a steady, open hand
Happy birthday, Bob
Best man I know
(Bob, we love you)

[Verse 2]
Now the rod bends on Lake Conroe
And your grin comes easy there
Sun on the water, quiet line
No worry in the air
From the docks to Sunday supper
You still bring the calm we need

[Pre-Chorus]
Every cast and every story
Says what this family means

[Chorus]
Happy birthday, Bob
We love you so
Happy birthday, Bob
You made our home
For the three kids you carried
With a steady, open hand
Happy birthday, Bob
Best man I know
(Bob, we love you)

[Bridge]
Forty years of showing up
That kind of love don’t fade
You taught us how to stand back up
And face the long hard days
Now let the water hold your worries
Let the evening soften through

[Chorus]
Happy birthday, Bob
We love you so
Happy birthday, Bob
You made our home
For the three kids you carried
With a steady, open hand
Happy birthday, Bob
Best man I know
(Bob, we love you)
title: Bob on Conroe
